name: Conference Manager
description: Manage conference inscriptions, payments, and lodging assignments.
author: WordJS

permissions.reason: Run the plugin's own compiled interface in the browser: its admin page. Without it the host does not serve these bundles and that interface does not load.
Required to list conferences, hotels, rooms, and inscriptions (own prefixed tables only).
Required to create/update conferences, hotels, rooms, and inscriptions (own prefixed tables only).
Required to register the conference manager API endpoints under /api/v1/plugin/conference-manager/*.
Required to add the conference manager to the admin sidebar.
Required to find WordJS users to add to the conference team (staff roles).
